angle: Distinguishing the 3 hand-written go-to-protobuf source files (parser.go, package.go, cmd.go) from the 76 auto-generated generated.protomessage.pb.go output files — tests whether models understand which files require manual changes vs which are produced by the generator
difficulty_notes: Models will almost certainly list the 76 generated.protomessage.pb.go files as requiring 'manual changes' — but those are the auto-generated OUTPUT of the tool; they simply won't be produced anymore when the generator runs. The correct answer is the 3 hand-written source files inside the go-to-protobuf package. Additionally, models may list hack/update-codegen.sh, but that script just invokes the generator binary and does not need to change. This is a precise test of understanding the code-generation pipeline boundary.
